pkgTitle: Warm starts for external and coupled units
title: Q7: the speed-up claim for neighbouring designs
body: Restarting a coupled run from a neighbouring design's solution (feed temperature +2 K) was meant to need fewer outer iterations. On the real reactor loop both took 4 iterations, and the warm run took longer (223 s against 182 s). Restarting the same design still works (1 iteration, 25 s instead of 194 s).

options.label: Record the check as failed and withdraw that claim
